# JARVIS WSL AI Platform — CEO Setup Plan
**Generated by /plan-ceo-review on 2026-08-19**
**Branch:** main | **Mode:** CATHEDRAL (Scope Expansion) | **Approach:** Balanced Optimization (Approach B)
**Repo:** venu/Proposals/Jarvis

---

## Vision

### 10x Check
Transform JARVIS from a fragile cron-based job bot into a **self-healing, observable, multi-model AI automation platform** that runs reliably on 4GB VRAM, scales to 10x load, and makes adding new automations as simple as writing a config file.

### Platonic Ideal
A developer adds a new automation by creating one directory with a `config.yaml`. The platform handles: browser pooling, model routing, checkpointing, observability, alerting, and deployment. Zero boilerplate. The system tells you when it's broken before you notice.

## Accepted Scope (Added to This Plan)

### Infrastructure Fixes (Critical)
- [ ] Fix Docker CMD syntax (`--headful=false` → remove flag, use `--headful` only when true)
- [ ] Install Ollama in WSL (systemd service, 0.0.0.0:11434)
- [ ] Pull 5 q4_K_M models: `llama3.2:3b-instruct-q4_K_M`, `phi4:mini`, `qwen2.5-coder:3b-instruct-q4_K_M`, `gemma2:2b-instruct-q4_K_M`, `nomic-embed-text:latest`
- [ ] Fix PostgreSQL init script (remove ignore of `/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*`)
- [ ] Fix Pinterest Dockerfile (`fonts-unifont` → `fonts-noto-color-emoji`)
- [ ] Install `uv` for Python package management
- [ ] Increase WSL RAM to 7GB (`.wslconfig`: `memory=7GB`)
- [ ] Configure Ollama CPU offload (`LLAMA_CPU_LAYERS=999`, `num_gpu=-1` for fallback)

### Critical Gap Fixes (17 items from Section 2)
- [ ] Cron overlap lock (`flock` on PID file)
- [ ] Selector failure → vision fallback (wire existing `page.fallback()`)
- [ ] Ollama timeout → retry + CPU offload fallback + alert
- [ ] Ollama down → circuit breaker + local fallback model
- [ ] Model not found → auto-pull or fallback
- [ ] VRAM OOM → auto CPU offload (`num_gpu=-1`)
- [ ] Malformed JSON from Ollama → validate + fallback response
- [ ] Model refusal → detect pattern → retry/skip
- [ ] Browser launch failure → healthcheck + alert
- [ ] Session corrupt → try/except → delete corrupt → fresh login
- [ ] Pool exhausted → increase pool size + queue monitoring
- [ ] FK violation → validate before insert
- [ ] Disk full → disk space monitor + alert
- [ ] Ollama connection refused → healthcheck + alert + fallback

### Accepted Expansions
- [ ] **Multi-Model Router** — FastAPI service routing to best model per task type
- [ ] **GPU Metrics Exporter** — `nvidia-smi` → Prometheus → Grafana
- [ ] **Prompt Injection Defense** — Sanitizer for job descriptions before LLM
- [ ] **Ollama Model Warm-up** — systemd `ExecStartPre` hits `/api/generate` on boot
- [ ] **Staging Environment** — `docker compose --profile staging` for pre-prod testing
- [ ] **Custom JARVIS Grafana Dashboard** — Tailored panels: jobs needing review, portal errors, model performance
- [ ] **CLI Rich TUI** — `jarvis status` terminal dashboard with live logs, stats, model health
- [ ] **Mobile Alert Routing** — Grafana OnCall / ntfy.sh for critical alerts on phone

### Deferred to TODOS.md
All items marked "Deferred" above → will be added to TODOS.md with context.

## Dream State Delta

| Dimension | Current | This Plan Achieves | 12-Month Ideal |
|-----------|---------|-------------------|----------------|
| **Reliability** | Restart loops, silent failures | Zero silent failures, self-healing | Self-healing + auto-rollback |
| **Observability** | None deployed | Full stack + GPU metrics + custom dashboard | Joy to operate |
| **AI Capability** | Single model, cold starts | 5 models, warm, multi-model router | Specialized models per task |
| **Performance** | 30-60s/job, sequential | Warm models, parallel-ready | 10x throughput |
| **Security** | Plaintext secrets, prompt injection | Prompt defense, secrets plan | Encrypted secrets, auth proxy |
| **Testing** | Zero coverage | Basic pyramid planned | Contract + visual regression |
| **Deployment** | Manual, risky | Staging env, verification checklist | Blue/green + auto-rollback |
| **Developer Experience** | Fragile, opaque | TUI dashboard, mobile alerts | One-command new automation |

## Error & Rescue Registry (Critical Gaps Only)

| CODEPATH | FAILURE MODE | RESCUED? | TEST? | USER SEES | LOGGED |
|----------|--------------|----------|-------|-----------|--------|
| Cron trigger | Overlap (duplicate run) | **N** → FIX | N | Silent duplicates | N |
| Portal scrape | Selector changed | **N** → FIX (vision) | N | Job fails | Y |
| Ollama call | Timeout (30s) | **N** → FIX (retry+offload) | N | Silent fail | N |
| Ollama call | Connection refused | **N** → FIX (circuit breaker) | N | All AI fails | N |
| Ollama call | Model not loaded (404) | **N** → FIX (auto-pull) | N | Crash | N |
| Ollama call | VRAM OOM (500) | **N** → FIX (CPU offload) | N | Crash | N |
| Ollama response | Malformed JSON | **N** → FIX (validate+fallback) | N | Crash | N |
| Ollama response | Model refusal | **N** → FIX (detect+skip) | N | Treated as valid | N |
| Browser launch | Launch failed | **N** → FIX (healthcheck+alert) | N | Container crash | Y |
| Browser action | Selector not found | **N** → FIX (vision fallback) | N | Job fails | Y |
| Session load | Corrupt JSON | **N** → FIX (delete+relogin) | N | Crash | N |
| DB pool | Exhausted | **N** → FIX (increase+monitor) | N | All DB ops fail | N |
| DB insert | FK violation | **N** → FIX (validate) | N | Crash | N |
| Disk | Full (ENOSPC) | **N** → FIX (monitor+alert) | N | Silent corruption | N |
| Ollama service | Down | **N** → FIX (healthcheck+alert) | N | All AI fails | N |

## Implementation Tasks

Synthesized from this review's findings. Each task derives from a specific finding above.

### P1 — Blocks Ship (Critical Fixes)

- [ ] **T1 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Fix Docker CMD syntax in job-automation Dockerfile
  - Surfaced by: System Audit / Section 1 — `CMD ["python", "run.py", "--headful=false"]` fails
  - Files: `automations/job-automation/Dockerfile`
  - Verify: `docker build ... && docker run ... python run.py --help` (no error)

- [ ] **T2 (P1, human: ~1h / CC: ~10min)** — Install Ollama in WSL + pull 5 models + systemd service
  - Surfaced by: System Audit — Ollama not installed
  - Files: `/etc/systemd/system/ollama.service`, shell commands
  - Verify: `ollama list` shows 5 models; `curl localhost:11434/api/tags` works

- [ ] **T3 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Fix PostgreSQL init script (remove ignore line)
  - Surfaced by: System Audit — init script ignores `/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*`
  - Files: `init-scripts/` (check content), `docker-compose.yml` healthcheck
  - Verify: `docker compose up postgres` → healthcheck passes → schemas created

- [ ] **T4 (P1, human: ~30min / CC: ~5min)** — Fix Pinterest Dockerfile font package
  - Surfaced by: System Audit — `fonts-unifont` not in Debian Trixie
  - Files: `automations/pinterest/Dockerfile`
  - Verify: `docker build automations/pinterest` succeeds

- [ ] **T5 (P1, human: ~15min / CC: ~2min)** — Install `uv` in WSL
  - Surfaced by: System Audit — `uv` not found
  - Files: Shell command
  - Verify: `uv --version` works

- [ ] **T6 (P1, human: ~15min / CC: ~2min)** — Increase WSL RAM to 7GB
  - Surfaced by: System Audit — 6GB cap limits concurrent workloads
  - Files: `/mnt/c/Users/Venu/.wslconfig` (`memory=7GB`)
  - Verify: `wsl --shutdown && wsl` → `free -h` shows ~7GB

- [ ] **T7 (P1, human: ~2h / CC: ~15min)** — Implement cron overlap lock (`flock`)
  - Surfaced by: Section 2 — Critical Gap: duplicate applications
  - Files: `jarvis_scheduler.sh`, `run.py` (wrapper)
  - Verify: Run cron twice simultaneously → second exits with "already running"

- [ ] **T8 (P1, human: ~2h / CC: ~15min)** — Wire vision fallback for selector failures
  - Surfaced by: Section 2 — Critical Gap: selector changes cause silent failures
  - Files: `jarvis_browser.py` (already has `fallback`), portal clients
  - Verify: Break a selector → `page.fallback("click apply")` works

- [ ] **T9 (P1, human: ~3h / CC: ~20min)** — Ollama resilience: timeout retry, CPU offload, circuit breaker
  - Surfaced by: Section 2 — 5 critical gaps around Ollama failures
  - Files: `policy.py`, new `circuit_breaker.py`
  - Verify: Kill Ollama mid-run → fallback to CPU model → alert fires

- [ ] **T10 (P1, human: ~1h / CC: ~5min)** — Disk space monitor + alert
  - Surfaced by: Section 2 — Critical Gap: silent corruption on disk full
  - Files: New `disk_monitor.py`, cron job, alert_manager.py
  - Verify: `df` shows >85% → email alert
